scans.answer_at_t_val: The blue target is cos(x) and the center is x=0. Reflecting across the x-axis gives -cos(x). Its degree-two Taylor polynomial at 0 has c0=-1, c1=0, c2=1/2, so P(x)=-1+(1/2)x^2.
